integrity: Theorem supported by horizontal-section proof, Alexandrov--Fenchel inequalities and reproducible exact rational checks. Special simplex truncations are recognized as previously published; historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Sharp lower coefficients hold only for frusta whose two parallel sections are homothetic about one common center. No upper universal Godbersen inequality, nonhomothetic-frustum classification, or independent priority certification is claimed. The closest original arXiv primary work could be inspected only through abstract-level metadata because full-text access failed.
title: Sharp reflected mixed-volume recursion and symmetric-base extremality for homothetic frusta
